purpose: Assess available temporal fields and calculate conditional resolved-flow exposure without a new climate run.

cm1.provenance: Every selected case retains case/build identity, control-file SHA256 and selected-field byte hashes in the result. Archives remain external under climate/crm/runs.
cm1.inspection: Read scalar GrADS layout, metadata times, grid interfaces, stationary periodic boundary flags, case forcing and restart identity. Reused the field reader and CM1 Exner conversion from turbulence.py; humidity uses the Murphy–Koop ice-saturation equation already present in flakes.py.
cm1.limitation: The selected second active window uses A28_dim5 forcing, not the separate301 K resort column. It is selected storm activity, not an occurrence sample. Explicit mixing and external nudging/advection tendencies mean kinematic tracers do not label conserved material parcels.

records.reading_rule: Global native T21 grid, sampled every 3 Earth hours. Winds are at the lowest sigma level. Surface stress is the model's downward momentum transfer; its density closure uses surface temperature and the configured dry-gas constant. Wave forcing requires an explicit surface coupling rule.

gcm.reading: The source gcm_profiles.py identifies ordinary outputs as approximately3-day means. They are appropriate for forcing/climatology and cannot recover convective particle histories. The inspected instantaneous wave products have3-hour sampling and lowest-level fields; they do not export upper-air vertical velocity and cloud water. Their raw spectral archives were not decoded again.
gcm.access: NetCDF4 header read with the already installed climate environment from the main checkout, read-only. No main-checkout file was modified; scipy could not read this HDF5-backed member. Existing .npz product metadata read directly.

prior_snow_controls.reading: Read evidence assessment and prescribed depth controls. Their persistent saturated column and total simulation duration do not supply observed particle histories; no old producer/result is changed.

rights: Only derived diagnostics, source identities and synthetic test arrays are committed. Full climate field arrays remain external; no outside paper bytes are copied.
